summary: International Certificate in Wealth and Investment Management Training
lede: Wealth and investment management brings client profiling, asset allocation and portfolio monitoring together to align investments with client goals. This training is for investment and advisory professionals who need to develop client profiles, select investment vehicles, set portfolio risk limits and explain results; it also covers drafting an Investment Policy Statement, stress-testing portfolios and measuring risk-adjusted performance.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals entering the wealth management sector or those looking to formalize their investment expertise with global best practices.
modules: Foundations of Wealth and Investment Management
Modern Portfolio Theory and Asset Allocation
Investment Vehicle Selection and Due Diligence
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial markets and be comfortable with fundamental mathematical calculations. No prior experience in portfolio management is required, though familiarity with Microsoft Excel is highly recommended for the practical exercises.
